description: Defines the GatewayDiscoveryModel class responsible for discovering and managing network gateways via Bonjour/mDNS, including starting/stopping discovery, logging, and processing discovered gateways.

classes.name: GatewayDiscoveryModel
classes.description: Manages network gateway discovery using Bonjour/mDNS, maintains list of gateways, handles logging, and updates discovery status.

classes.name: DebugLogEntry
classes.description: Represents a log entry with timestamp and message for debugging purposes.

classes.name: DiscoveredGateway
classes.description: Represents a network gateway discovered via Bonjour, including its properties such as name, endpoint, ports, and security info.

methods.name: setDebugLoggingEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables debug logging, clearing logs when disabled and adding initial logs when enabled.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts network discovery for gateways across configured domains, setting up browsers and handling results.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops all ongoing discovery, cancels browsers, and resets internal state.

methods.name: recomputeGateways
methods.description: Recomputes the list of gateways based on current discovery results, tracking additions and removals.

methods.name: updateStatusText
methods.description: Updates the status text based on current browser states and discovery activity.

methods.name: prettyState
methods.description: Returns a string representation of NWBrowser.State for logging.

methods.name: appendDebugLog
methods.description: Adds a message to the debug log if logging is enabled, maintaining a maximum of 200 entries.

methods.name: prettifyInstanceName
methods.description: Normalizes and cleans up gateway instance names for display.

methods.name: txtValue
methods.description: Extracts a trimmed string value from a dictionary for a given key.

methods.name: txtIntValue
methods.description: Extracts an integer value from a dictionary for a given key.

methods.name: txtBoolValue
methods.description: Determines boolean value from a string in a dictionary for a given key.
